files.reason: Answer kind 'other'. SubmittedAnswer accepts 'other' and keeps own/ask only so old logs load. Question.replies/must_settle replace asks. On submit, an Other goes into the thread. Own/ask are refused, and the Other limit moves to Claude's side. pending adds must_settle. MAX_ASKS becomes MAX_REPLIES.

A decision with the question_id of a question awaiting a reply closes that question. Each awaiting question needs exactly one reply or one such decision. No reply is accepted once must_settle is set. Questions settled in the turn count as closed for done.
AnswerDraft kinds become choice and other. An Other draft may be empty while the owner types.
The draft PUT no longer has an ask limit. /api/grill returns max_replies.

New tests for Other answers, settling, the limit of 3, refused own/ask, and loading 0.1.9 files. The existing own/ask tests are rewritten for Other, or dropped where Other replaces them (the fourth-ask test becomes the must-settle test).
Rewrite the draft-kind cases for choice/other: an empty Other is allowed, own and ask are refused.
max_replies in /api/grill. An Other draft is accepted after 3 replies (this replaces the fourth-ask test). Submitting an Other draft.
Today's examples/grill.json, verbatim: a 0.1.9 file with an own answer, an ask in a thread and own/ask log entries, which must still load.
Assert that the page grill instructions cover Other answers (settle or reply), must_settle after 3 replies, and one-line decisions.

The demo in the new format, with the owner to answer. Round 1 is answered: a choice with a note, and an Other settled by a decision. Round 2 is open: a fresh question, a question with one Claude reply, and one with 3 replies, where Other is final. The title, decisions (d1-d3) and out_of_scope stay the same, so test_decisions_md keeps passing.
The same demo with every question answered and done: true, to show the Yes/No final step.
Answer kind 'other'. AnswerDraft kinds choice|other. max_replies.
responded for Other. pick (keeps the typed text). otherIsFinal. answerParts replaces answerLine. decisionsByTopic and replacedCount.
Tests for the new and changed helpers. The asksLeft and answerLine tests go.
Remembers whether the decisions list is open, in browser storage, with a safe fallback (like theme.ts).
Radio buttons for the choices plus Other. One box under the picked option, with its hint. The own and ask boxes go. The thread is shown as the conversation.
Tidy answered rows: a tick, the title, the answer in bold and the note in grey, and a click shows the full question. Each round gets a heading. The rows no longer use button.link.
Yes / No. No opens a required box with a hint, and Send reopens the grill.
Can be collapsed, and the state is remembered. Decisions are grouped by topic, each with its choice and why. Replaced ones sit behind 'Show replaced (N)'. The '(from …)' tails go.

New structure. The broken-files banner, the sticky Claude banner and the title are direct children of main, so the banner sticks for the whole page. Below them is a rounds column with a 'Round N' heading for every round, and a sticky decisions aside. This replaces the grid-row hack that left the gap.
Page tests for the new card, the answered rows, the final step, the decisions panel and the hints. The own/ask/Not yet tests are rewritten.
On submit, an Other goes into the thread, as on the real server. ask is dropped.
max_replies in the grill builder.

Page grill: answers are choice (maybe with a note) or other. For each other, either settle it with a decision whose question_id is that question, or reply. must_settle means a decision is required. Keep each decision to one line: a short decision title and a short choice. The reopen event follows the owner's No.

Step 0 describes the new controls: options plus Other, Yes/No, and the collapsible decisions list. The API rows change: draft kinds choice|other, Other goes into the thread on submit, max_replies, no fourth-ask 422. The grill_submitted kinds change too.

How to open the grill page with demo data, from the repo root. First build the page once: `npm --prefix plugins/plan-review/web run build`. Then copy examples/grill.json (or grill-done.json) to .claude/work/grill-demo/grill.json and run `uv run --project plugins/plan-review plan-review serve grill-demo`.

A line for #56 under a new `### Unreleased` heading in plan-review's section, as RELEASING.md asks. It says own/ask answers are gone, and that a grill_drafts.json left over from 0.1.10 with own/ask drafts can be deleted.

tests.name: test_an_other_answer_goes_into_the_thread_and_keeps_the_question_open
tests.behaviour: Submitting kind 'other' with text appends an owner message to the question's thread. answer stays None, and the question is awaiting a reply.

tests.name: test_a_submit_needs_exactly_one_valid_response_per_open_question (Other cases)
tests.behaviour: An 'other' with blank text is refused with 'answers.N.text: needed for Other'. The existing parametrized cases switch from own/ask to other.

tests.name: test_own_and_ask_submissions_are_no_longer_accepted
tests.behaviour: Submitting kind 'own' or 'ask' is refused with one line naming the kind and saying to pick a choice or Other. Nothing is written.

tests.name: test_a_grill_json_from_0_1_9_with_own_and_ask_still_loads
tests.behaviour: tests/fixtures/grill-0.1.9.json loads. The own answer keeps kind 'own' and its text, the thread keeps the ask, and pending() describes the logged own/ask answers.

tests.name: test_a_decision_for_an_awaiting_question_settles_it_with_the_other_text
tests.behaviour: After an Other, a turn with a decision whose question_id is that question closes it: answer is kind 'other', with the owner's last message as text. No reply is needed.

tests.name: test_a_reply_to_an_other_keeps_the_question_open_for_another_pick
tests.behaviour: A reply (optionally revised) to an awaiting Other is accepted. The question stays open, and the owner can then submit a choice for it. This adapts test_asking_back_keeps_the_question_open_and_the_next_turn_must_reply.

tests.name: test_an_awaiting_question_needs_one_reply_or_one_settling_decision_not_both
tests.behaviour: A turn that neither replies to nor settles an awaiting question is refused, naming it. So is one that does both.

tests.name: test_after_three_replies_an_other_is_still_accepted_and_must_be_settled
tests.behaviour: After 3 Claude replies, a 4th Other is accepted on submit. A turn that replies to it is refused ('must be settled with a decision'), and a settling decision is accepted. This replaces test_a_fourth_ask_back_on_one_question_is_refused.

tests.name: test_settling_the_last_open_question_and_done_in_one_turn_is_accepted
tests.behaviour: When the only open question is awaiting a reply, a turn that settles it with a decision and sets done: true is accepted, and the grill is done.

tests.name: test_pending_marks_an_other_that_must_be_settled
tests.behaviour: pending() describes an Other as kind 'other' with its text. must_settle is true only after Claude has replied 3 times.

tests.name: test_a_draft_needs_what_its_kind_needs
tests.behaviour: A choice without choice_id is refused, and so are kind 'own' and 'ask'. {kind: other} with no or empty text is a valid draft.

tests.name: test_api_grill_returns_the_state_with_the_reply_limit
tests.behaviour: GET /api/grill carries max_replies: 3 and no max_asks.

tests.name: test_an_other_draft_is_accepted_after_three_replies_and_own_or_ask_are_422
tests.behaviour: PUT a {kind: other} draft on a question with 3 replies: 200. PUT {kind: own} or {kind: ask}: 422. An answered question is still 404.

tests.name: test_submitting_an_other_draft_tells_claude_its_text
tests.behaviour: Submitting a choice draft and an Other draft records both. The grill_submitted event lists {kind: other, text}, and the Other question stays open.

tests.name: test_the_example_grills_load_as_an_open_round_and_a_done_grill
tests.behaviour: examples/grill.json loads in the new format, on the owner's turn. It has a settled Other, an open question with a reply, and a must_settle question. examples/grill-done.json loads with done true and no open question. Neither has kind own or ask.

tests.name: test_page_grill_explains_other_answers_and_one_line_decisions
tests.behaviour: SKILL.md step 1 mentions kind `other`, settling with a decision's `question_id` or replying, `must_settle`, and keeping each decision to one line. It no longer mentions `own` or `ask` answers.

tests.name: a response is a pick that still exists, or an Other with text
tests.behaviour: A choice draft with an existing choice_id counts. An Other with text counts. An Other with blank text does not.

tests.name: picking another option keeps the text already typed
tests.behaviour: pick({choice b, text 'x'}, 'c') gives {choice c, text 'x'}. pick(..., 'other') gives {other, text 'x'}. pick(undefined, 'a') gives {choice a}.

tests.name: Other is final once Claude has replied the limit
tests.behaviour: otherIsFinal counts Claude's messages against max: false at 2 replies, true at 3.

tests.name: an answered question reads as its answer and note
tests.behaviour: A choice gives its label and the note (or null). An 'other' or old 'own' answer gives its text with no note.

tests.name: decisions are grouped by topic, replaced ones only when asked
tests.behaviour: Topics come in first-seen order, each with its decisions in order. Replaced decisions are left out unless withReplaced, and then marked replaced. replacedCount counts them.

tests.name: each question shows its choices plus Other as radios, with no text box until a pick
tests.behaviour: The radios are the choice labels then 'Other'. Nothing is picked and there is no textbox in the card. There are no 'Your own answer' or 'Ask back' boxes.

tests.name: picking a choice opens one optional box with its hint, and the note is saved with the pick
tests.behaviour: After picking Choice b, the card has one textbox with placeholder 'Add a few words to your choice (optional)'. Submit is enabled with it empty. Typing saves {choice b, text}.

tests.name: picking Other opens a required box and Submit waits until it is filled
tests.behaviour: After picking Other, one textbox has placeholder 'Type your own option, a question, or a comment' and is required. Submit stays disabled until text is typed. Then the draft is {other, text}.

tests.name: switching options moves the typed text to the new option's box
tests.behaviour: Type a note under Choice a, then pick Choice c: the single box under c holds the same text, and the saved draft is {choice c, text}.

tests.name: after three replies, Other's hint says it now counts as the answer
tests.behaviour: On a question whose thread has 3 Claude replies, picking Other shows a box whose placeholder says the text is taken as the answer. Other is still enabled.

tests.name: Claude's reply to an Other shows under the question, which stays open to pick again
tests.behaviour: After the grill updates with a reply, the card shows the owner's Other and Claude's reply, with the updated tag if revised. All radios are unpicked and the box is empty again. This adapts the two asked-back tests.

tests.name: an answered question is a row with a tick, the answer in bold and the note under it
tests.behaviour: The row shows the title, the choice label in a strong element and the note in a separate element. Clicking the row shows the explanation and choices. An old 'own' answer shows its text in bold.

tests.name: every round has a Round N heading, open or answered
tests.behaviour: With an answered round 1 and a half-answered round 2, the page has 'Round 1' and 'Round 2' headings. Round 2's heading comes before both its answered rows and its open cards.

tests.name: the final step asks Yes or No, and Yes confirms at once
tests.behaviour: When done, the page asks 'Is this the shared understanding?' with Yes and No buttons. There is no textbox and no Confirm or Not yet button. One click on Yes posts confirm, and the page reads Confirmed.

tests.name: No opens a required box with its hint, and Send reopens the grill
tests.behaviour: No shows a textbox with the placeholder "What's missing or wrong?". Send is disabled while it is blank. Typing and Send posts reopen with the text. A refused reopen says why. This adapts the Not yet tests.

tests.name: decisions are grouped by topic with their why, and replaced ones sit behind Show replaced
tests.behaviour: The panel shows one heading per topic, each decision in bold with its choice and why, and no '(from' text. A replaced decision is hidden until 'Show replaced (1)' is clicked, then it shows struck through. With nothing replaced there is no such link.

tests.name: the decisions list collapses and stays collapsed after a reload
tests.behaviour: The panel is open by default (aria-expanded true). Clicking its toggle hides the decisions and stores closed. A fresh render starts collapsed. When storage throws, it renders open.

tests.name: every text box on the grill page has a hint inside it
tests.behaviour: Open a card's choice box, an Other box and the No box. Every textbox on the page then has a non-empty placeholder.

risks.text: Some layout criteria can't be checked by the page tests, because the test browser (jsdom) does no layout: the sticky banner and decisions list, alignment, the two themes, and the banner no longer overlapping the theme switch.
risks.mitigation: Cover these with the styles.css change and the owner's own check. After the reviews, Claude opens the grill page with examples/grill.json and examples/grill-done.json (commands in CONTRIBUTING.md), in light and dark, at desktop width, and shows the owner. Fixes from that check go into #56 before the commit. The owner's screenshots in .claude/work/56/ list what must look fixed.

risks.text: A grill_drafts.json left over from 0.1.10 or earlier that holds an own or ask draft no longer fits AnswerDraft. It would show as a broken file on the page.
risks.mitigation: This only happens to a grill that is in progress across the upgrade. The broken-file banner from #55 names the file and keeps the questions on screen, and deleting the file (unsent answers only) clears it. The CHANGELOG line says so.

risks.text: The decisions list remembers open or closed in this browser, the way the theme switch does. Browsers keep that memory per address, and each `plan-review serve` gets a new port (for example 127.0.0.1:53121, then 127.0.0.1:60877 next time). So it is remembered while the page is open and across reloads, but a new `serve` starts it open again, as the theme does today. Is that fine? The other way is to keep it in .claude/work/preferences.json through the server, which is more work.
risks.mitigation: Assumed fine: same behaviour as the theme switch.

risks.text: Version: 0.1.10 is already released (tag plan-review--v0.1.10 on origin) and #56 changes shipped files, so the version guard fails CI without a bump.
risks.mitigation: Run scripts/set-version.sh 0.1.11 (file:version-pyproject, file:version-plugin, file:version-lock), and put the #56 line under `### Unreleased` in CHANGELOG.md. The owner moves it under 0.1.11 when releasing.

risks.text: On the plan page the banner sits inside the header. The page is one window tall and only the tab's panel scrolls, so the banner stays in view already. position: sticky on the shared .claude-banner rule only matters if the page itself scrolls (a very short window), and then it sticks only while the header is in view. On the grill page the banner is a direct child of the page's main element, so it sticks for the whole page.
risks.mitigation: The plan page is not restyled, per the decisions. The implementer checks in the browser that the banner stays visible while a long tab (Tests, Files) scrolls. If it doesn't, the same sticky rule moves to the header element.

risks.text:
Some assumptions, none settled in decisions.md:
- A settled Other's answered row shows the owner's last Other text in bold.
- A turn may not both reply to and settle the same question.
- A decision for an open question with no Other pending does not close it (as today).
- /api/grill's max_asks is renamed max_replies.
- The '(from <question>)' tail is dropped from the decisions list.
risks.mitigation: The owner can change any of these in plan review; each touches one test.
